reference_sql:
WITH copied_sets AS (  -- one row per set of two or more matching lines
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders
FROM copied_sets
alternatives: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur)
SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders FROM sets WHERE n > 1
